module_summary: Triangle-wave generator: a 2-state up/down direction FSM drives a 5-bit up/down counter output that ramps 0 to 31 and back.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Direction state: counting up or down, flips at wave extremes 31 and 0.

anchors.name: wave
anchors.why: 5-bit up/down counter output forming the triangle waveform.

groups.name: triangle_generator
groups.description: Direction FSM controlling an up/down counter waveform output.
